    "name": "SIAS University (Main Campus)",
    "name_zh": "郑州西亚斯学院主校区",
    "description": "西亚斯学院的中心地带，汇集了现代化的教学设施、研究机构和校园生活空间。它是高等教育和创新学习的典范，是学生们学习和成长的核心区域。",
    "description_en": "The core area of SIAS University, gathering modern teaching facilities, research institutions, and campus life spaces. It is a model of higher education and innovative learning, serving as the central hub for student growth.",
    "latitude": 34.4016,
    "longitude": 113.7361,
    "category": "校园"
  },
  {
    "name": "SIAS Library",
    "name_zh": "西亚斯图书馆",
    "description": "学院的知识殿堂，提供丰富的学术资源、学习空间和安静的阅读环境。它不仅是书籍的存储地，更是学生进行深度研究和学术交流的重要场所。",
    "description_en": "The academic hall of the college, providing rich academic resources, study spaces, and a quiet reading environment. It is not just a repository of books, but a vital place for students to conduct deep research and academic exchange.",
    "latitude": 34.4008,
    "longitude": 113.7374,
    "category": "校园"
  },
  {
    "name": "SIAS Grand Plaza",
    "name_zh": "西亚斯中心广场",
    "description": "校园内的主要公共聚集地，是学生们进行社交、休息和户外活动的场所。广场设计开阔，是校园文化和活力展现的中心。",
    "description_en": "The main public gathering area within the campus, serving as a place for students to socialize, rest, and engage in outdoor activities. The plaza is designed to be open, showcasing the campus's culture and vibrancy.",
    "latitude": 34.4011,
    "longitude": 113.7366,
    "category": "校园"
  },
  {
    "name": "SIAS Arts Center",
    "name_zh": "西亚斯艺术中心",
    "description": "致力于培养学生艺术潜能的场所。这里设有各类艺术工作室和表演空间，是校园文化活动和艺术创作的孵化器，丰富了校园的精神生活。",
    "description_en": "A venue dedicated to nurturing students' artistic potential. It features various art studios and performance spaces, acting as an incubator for campus cultural activities and artistic creation, enriching the spiritual life of the campus.",
    "latitude": 34.4032,
    "longitude": 113.7387,
    "category": "校园"
  },
  {
    "name": "SIAS Sports Center",
    "name_zh": "西亚斯体育馆",
    "description": "提供全面的体育训练和竞技环境。体育馆是学生健康和团队精神的象征，是校园体育活动和健康生活的重要组成部分。",
    "description_en": "Provides comprehensive athletic training and competitive environments. The sports center symbolizes student health and team spirit, forming a crucial part of the campus's physical activities and healthy lifestyle.",
    "latitude": 34.3989,
    "longitude": 113.7392,
    "category": "校园"
  },
  {
    "name": "SIAS North Gate",
    "name_zh": "西亚斯学院北门",
    "description": "学院的入口之一，是学生和访客进入校园的门户。它不仅是物理上的界限，也是校园形象和身份的象征，标志着学习旅程的开始。",
    "description_en": "One of the college's entrances, serving as the gateway for students and visitors entering the campus. It is not only a physical boundary but also a symbol of the campus's image and identity, marking the start of the learning journey.",
    "latitude": 34.4059,
    "longitude": 113.7353,
    "category": "校园"
  },
  {
    "name": "Henan Guoli University",
    "name_zh": "河南工业与应用技术学院",
    "description": "位于校园附近的另一所高等教育机构，代表了区域内的教育资源和学术氛围。它为学生提供了接触不同教育体系和学术交流的机会。",
    "description_en": "Another higher education institution located near the campus, representing the regional educational resources and academic atmosphere. It offers students opportunities to interact with different educational systems and academic exchanges.",
    "latitude": 34.4139,
    "longitude": 113.7291,
    "category": "校园"
  },
  {
    "name": "Xinzheng Huanghe Wetland Park",
    "name_zh": "新郑黄河湿地公园",
    "description": "位于校园周边的一处重要自然景观。湿地公园是生态保护区，为校园提供了一个远离城市喧嚣、体验自然美景的休憩之地。",
    "description_en": "An important natural landscape located near the campus. The wetland park is an ecological reserve, providing a place of rest and natural beauty away from the city noise for the campus community.",
    "latitude": 34.4126,
    "longitude": 113.7662,
    "category": "自然"
  }
]
